output.subject: We have received your feedback about your recent call
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We want to confirm that we have received your complaint about your recent call.

You told us you were upset about how long you waited on hold before you could speak with someone. You also mentioned that you had called with a question about your escrow balance, and that this question was resolved once you reached a representative.

We understand how frustrating it can be to spend a long time waiting when you simply need an answer, and we're sorry for the frustration this experience caused you. Your feedback matters to us, and we appreciate you letting us know how the wait affected you.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If there is anything else you would like us to know in the meantime, please feel free to reply to this message.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
